_comment: Manual chair overrides — highest precedence in build_committee_chair_lookup(). This file used to carry committees that had never appeared as a lead in our archive, because joint-hearing agendas only name the lead committee's chair. council_roster.json now covers every committee and subcommittee straight from council.nyc.gov, so those five entries became redundant and were removed on 2026-07-25 (verified: removing them changed no lookup result). Add an entry here only to override what the roster and archive already produce — e.g. a chair who changes mid-cycle before you have refreshed the roster, or a name form you want rendered differently. Keys are matched loosely, so '&' vs 'and', casing and punctuation do not matter.
